title: Not sure why stuck in a place of allusion and antithetical allegory words just fly in time to fill in missing rhymes like a Van Gogh remixed with graf
summary: Not sure why stuck in a place of allusion and antithetical allegory words just fly in time to fill in missing rhymes like a Van Gogh remixed with graffiti in a bathroom #poetryport

why
